summary: On-call contractor cannot sign into internal-alerting: SCIM-provisioned roles double-encoded causing SSO failure
description:
Issue summary: An on-call contractor (external vendor) cannot complete SSO login to the internal-alerting app. The Okta sign-in redirects to /auth/error with a SAML/SSO failure. Impact: on-call unable to acknowledge alerts during a paging window. Scope: single contractor account provisioned this morning via automated SCIM job.

Observed behavior: After successful Okta authentication, the application receives the user attributes but the RBAC service rejects the role claim and the session terminates. The UI shows 'SSO error: invalid role payload' and an HTTP 401 is recorded in the auth gateway logs.
steps_to_reproduce: Provision a new contractor via our HR->Okta SCIM sync with contractor entitlements set to 'ops-alerts' in the HR system.
Attempt to sign into internal-alerting via Okta SSO as the contractor user.
Observe redirect to /auth/error and 401 in the auth gateway, and 'invalid role payload' in RBAC service logs.
logs: rbac-service (2026-03-10T09:42:31Z) - ERROR parseRoleClaim: expected array, got string: '[\"ops-alerts\"]'
scim-provisioner (2026-03-10T09:35:10Z) - INFO provisionUser contractor_jdoe outline roles='["ops-alerts"]' (string)
investigation_notes: 09:50 - Reproduced locally with a test contractor user. The Okta assertion contains a claim 'roles' whose value is a JSON-encoded string (e.g., "[\"ops-alerts\"]") rather than a native array. RBAC parser expects an array and fails when it sees the string.

10:10 - SCIM provisioner appears to be double-encoding the roles field: HR export -> SCIM transform wraps the list as a JSON string. This started after last week's SCIM transform PR (see related PR below).
10:35 - Temporary workaround: manual edit of the Okta user profile to replace the roles attribute with a native array value (done for contractor_jdoe). This restores login for that user.
11:00 - No other services affected so far; only identities provisioned since 2026-03-10 08:00 by the new transform are candidates. Not a global outage but P1 because of on-call impact.
Attached artifacts: auth-gateway traces, RBAC service stack traces, SCIM provisioner job logs, Slack thread #support-oncall-2026-03-10
resolution_notes: 12:05 - Rolled back SCIM transform that introduced double-encoding to the previous working version; new provision attempts now emit roles as native arrays.
12:20 - Manually patched 2 contractor accounts that were provisioned with the bad payload. Confirmed successful SSO logins and alert acknowledgement ability.

12:45 - Deployed a guard in RBAC service to treat single-string role claims that parse as JSON arrays as a fallback (short-term mitigation). Added a ticket for a proper tolerant parser and schema validation in the SCIM pipeline.
Follow-up required: Create a SCIM pre-flight schema validation job and add unit tests to prevent double-encoding regressions. Owner: infra-auth (assigned to Marco Liu). ETA: 2026-03-19.
